Rowland Heights, California

Rowland Heights real estate

An unincorporated community with a busy dining and shopping scene along Colima Road.

Living in Rowland Heights

About Rowland Heights.

Rowland Heights is an unincorporated community in Los Angeles County, between Hacienda Heights and Diamond Bar along the 60 freeway. Colima Road is lined with restaurants, markets, and shops, many of them Asian-owned.

Homes range from single-family neighborhoods on the hillsides to townhomes and condos near the main roads. Most of the area is served by Rowland Unified, with some parts in Hacienda La Puente Unified.

  • CountyLos Angeles (unincorporated)
  • School districtsRowland USD; parts of Hacienda La Puente USD
  • Getting aroundSR-60, with SR-57 nearby

School boundaries change. Always confirm the assigned schools for a specific address with the district.

Buying in Rowland Heights

How I help Rowland Heights buyers.

Because Rowland Heights is unincorporated, permits and many services run through Los Angeles County rather than a city hall. I help buyers check permit history before they commit.

  • Numbers first

    Recent sales and price per square foot on truly comparable homes, before you write an offer.

  • Quick replies

    Questions answered fast by call, text, or email, so you don't lose a home while you wait.

  • First-time buyer guidance

    From pre-approval to closing, one clear step at a time, with a lender introduction if you need one.
